reference_rules.town_id: Must match an authored town JSON file.
reference_rules.lot.block: Must match a block id in the referenced town.
reference_rules.lot.home_node: Must match a schedule node id in the referenced town.
reference_rules.lot.resident_slot: When present, must match an npc_slots id in the referenced town.
reference_rules.micro_schedule_nodes.block: Must match a block id in the referenced town.
reference_rules.micro_schedule_nodes.town_node: When present, must match a schedule node id in the referenced town.
reference_rules.neighborhood_routes.nodes: May reference neighborhood micro nodes or town schedule nodes.

building_profile.runtime_assignment_policy: Capacity and massing are authored here; actual resident assignments belong in save-state files.

interior_streaming_policy.runtime_rule: Attach only the selected lot interior; unload before loading another interior.

rules.pad_size_blocks: Must be greater than or equal to footprint.size_blocks on both axes.
rules.pad_local_offset: Should normally match footprint.local_offset so the building is centered on the foundation.
rules.cover_underlay_grid: True when the renderer should prevent the district grid from visually cutting through the building base.
rules.edge_style: Use clean_outer_perimeter_only for early HoloUtopia residential massing.

description: Safe-edit schema notes for HoloUtopia neighborhoods. Pass 13 adds cross-district residential infill with foundation-aligned exterior massing and highlight-only future interiors.
